build_augmentation: build image augmentation pipeline with resize and random flip from detectron2 config
read_image: read an image file into numpy array with EXIF orientation handling and format conversion
annotations_to_instances: convert dataset annotation dicts into detectron2 Instances object with boxes, classes, masks
transform_instance_annotations: apply geometric transforms to bounding boxes, segmentation masks, and keypoints of an instance
filter_empty_instances: filter out instances with empty or too-small bounding boxes and masks from an Instances object
